name: f1_fanout_r2
status: Mating-layout revision for formed sensor tails; circuit routing and physical validation pending

tab.basis: The entire physical package depth bounds the unresolved tip-stop location. The external tab envelope covers every stop in this interval; it is not a measured mating datum.

notes: Upper connectors rotate 180 degrees; their external stiffened tabs leave toward the PCB back edge instead of crossing the lower connectors.
The original fanout module and all other design packages are retained.
Electrical pin/net identities remain unchanged. The separate site-to-connector map assigns high CH4 to J5 and low CH5 to J4.
The test mux moves between connector rows. Its pull-downs occupy the opposite-face corridor between upper connectors; this removes their escape vias from the mux's dense lower-pad field.
Two mounting holes at the back retain the removable board between the connector columns.
The unused front holes are removed to leave room for explicit mux escape tracks. Earlier four-hole placement studies and routing failures are preserved.
The board contour is rounded inward; it must remain inside the earlier screened contact-access envelope.
Check actual mating, latch access, flexible sections, carrier and installed drive before treating this as a completed F1 assembly.
